name: Nuvio Enhanced Beta (Unofficial)
subtitle: Pre-release builds of Nuvio Enhanced
description:
A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

## New Feature: Smart Streams

**Find the right stream without scrolling.** All addon results can now be merged into one list and sorted by *Best match*, *Highest quality*, *Smallest file* or *Largest file*, or kept in addon order. Filter by resolution, HDR / Dolby Vision, codec, audio, source (Remux, Blu-ray, WEB-DL…), file size or *Instant only*. CAM and telesync copies are hidden by default.

**Best match knows your device.** The ranking checks what your phone or tablet can actually play:
- hardware HEVC and AV1 decoding and 4K support;
- the HDR formats your screen shows (Dolby Vision only where it decodes correctly);
- how much memory is available for 4K.

It also prefers instant streams and a sensible bitrate, and saves data on mobile networks.

**Your language first.** Streams in your preferred audio language (Settings → Playback → Audio) rank higher, then your secondary language and multi-audio releases.

**Play best for this device.** One tap plays the top match. Long-press it to see why it was picked.

**Smart auto-play.** A new stream selection mode (Settings → Playback → Stream auto-play) that waits for sources up to your stream timeout, picks the best match and starts playing. You don't need to tap anything. The loading screen shows how many sources have answered and the best candidate so far.
- If a stream fails to start and *Fall back to the next source* is on, the next ranked stream is tried.
- When the next episode plays, the same release group is preferred.

All Smart Streams preferences are in **Settings → Playback → Smart Streams**.

Thanks to @lalith14, whose fork started the sort, filters and *Play best for this device*.
